plan: My value is $9. I want to exit the ascending clock auction before paying more than $9. To do this, I need to bid slightly above what I expect the other bidders to bid, but below $9. Since this is round 1 of 1, there's no history to learn from. I will bid $5.50, hoping to stay in longer than others who might bid low, but exit before the price exceeds my value.

My value is $20. I want to avoid overpaying. Given this is round 1 of 1, I'll bid slightly above my value to increase my chance of winning, but not excessively. I'm anticipating other bidders will also bid above their values. A bid of $22 seems reasonable, aiming to exit before potentially higher bids push the price up significantly.

My value is $20. To maximize profit, I want to exit Stage 2 *after* the others. I'll bid slightly above my value, hoping others bid lower. Since this is the only round, I have no prior data.
